messages:
claire (AE): Customer (Ellipsis Health) wants to sign the POC orderform today. They attached a vendor security questionnaire and explicitly requested a KMS/HSM attestation and a clause about EU data residency. They also want milestone billing: $15k POC + $5k on activation. Can we route and sign today?

noah (sales-ops): OrderForm uploaded: https://drive.internal/po/ellipsis-poc. Template candidate: OrderForm-Milestones-v4. Default sign order = AE -> Customer -> Sales Manager -> Finance. We can override.

harry (finance): For $15k initial we need sales manager + finance reviewer. Finance requires vendor tax ID, billing contact, and PO number before invoicing. Regarding net terms: Net30 is standard; if they ask Net60 we need director approval. Also, AP prefers PO in the envelope with PO_NUMBER field set.

claire (AE): Buyer says they'll provide PO tonight. They want the KMS attestation text included in the envelope so its signed with the order. Their requested attestation phrasing: "Keys are HSM-backed, customer region-bound, and Redwood will provide attestation letter."

tiffany (legal): Two notes: 1) If the questionnaire or PO redlines our SLA or adds residency obligations we need to review BEFORE signing. 2) Legal doesn't usually sign OrderForms; we can be a reviewer in the envelope and attach the KMS addendum. If they insist on our legal signature because of SLA changes, escalate to me. I can do a limited-sign for narrow clauses but need to see exact language.

infra-bot: Recommended artifact: "KMS-Attestation-Template-v1" available at https://legal.internal/templates/kms-attest-v1.docx. SOC2 link: https://security.redwood/soc2. For HSM vendor claims we need infra to confirm compatibility; if they ask for vendor certificate, expect 24-48h.

noah (sales-ops): Proposed signer order to the DocuSign template: ["ae_placeholder","sales_manager","finance_billing","customer_exec"], with legal (tiffany) as reviewer post-sign. I'll set envelope custom field PO_NUMBER and attach KMS addendum + questionnaire.

harry (finance): That routing works. Finance needs the invoice breakup noted as line items in the orderform: POC fee and activation fee. AP prefers separate invoices but will accept milestone invoice. Please include billing contact email in envelope.

claire (AE): Buyer indicates urgency: start of POC dependent on signature today. If infra needs extra time for HSM confirmation they'll accept a follow-up attestation within 3 business days.

tiffany (legal): I'll prepare the KMS addendum with minimal attest language referencing the infra-bot template. Uploading now. If the PO contains any sentence like "Redwood warrants 99.99% uptime" instead of our standard SLA, we must redline.

noah (sales-ops): Draft envelope ready. Template: OrderForm-Milestones-v4; override sign order to the array above; attachments: KMS addendum, vendor questionnaire, PO when received. Will set PO_NUMBER field and include accounting CC.

harry (finance): Approved to proceed. Note: if buyer requests Net45/Net60, tag for director approval.

infra-bot: Quick check: the requested attestation wording referencing "HSM-backed" is fine as a non-technical attestation. For technical specifics (FIPS, vendor certs, key rotation schedule) we must defer to SRE.

claire (AE): PO just landed and uploaded. Noah - please send envelope and set sign order. I'll confirm customer exec signer.

noah (sales-ops): Sending envelope now. PO_NUMBER field populated, KMS addendum attached, legal set as reviewer, accounting CC'd. :white_check_mark:

harry (finance): AP copied and received PO. Will process invoices after signature.

tiffany (legal): I'll monitor for any post-sign redlines in the questionnaire. If buyer pushes SLA or residency language, I'll advise.

claire (AE): Thanks everyone  I'll kick off the POC as soon as signatures clear. Closing thread when fully executed. :rocket:
